thread:
claire: Proposal: 'Seed Studio' pilot — 160-seat cohort to test two credit delivery models (all-upfront vs drip) + two prompt template flows (Starter Kit vs Sample Apps). Goal: +15% week-1 activation and measurable drop in CPL. Quick takes? :seedling:

maya: Love the framing. Recommend split 80/80, randomize by cookie. All-upfront = 80 credits now; Drip = 30 credits now + 20 credits after 48h + 30 credits on engagement. Track churn of credits and time-to-first-success.

jamie: Nudge designs: Starter Kit = 6 curated templates + inline tips; Sample Apps = 4 mini-app examples with editable prompts. Primary activation = any generation >12 tokens + user flags useful. Secondary: time-to-first-success, webinar RSVP -> attendance.

nate: Creative: hero + two social cuts (15s / 30s). CTAs: "Claim Studio Credits" / "See Sample Apps". Need assets Wed EOD.

leah: Office hours: 4 sessions across NA/EU/APAC during week 1. Registration page live Mon. Email cadence: signup confirm, 48h drip note (for drip arm), 24h office-hour reminder, post-session replay with credit reminder (expire in 7 days). Also micro-survey after office hours to capture prompt usefulness.

aj: Routing plan: utm=seed_studio_516. Tag users by arm. If a user makes >3 requests in 24h mark as "engaged" and auto-invite to next office-hour. I'll implement attribution so webinar RSVPs can be tied back to initial arm.

samir: Infra: pre-warm Dedicated pool 30m before each office-hour. Set cap=20 GPUs for peak. Fallback to quantized variant at 75% util. Enable prefix caching for Starter Kit prompts and warm common KV entries. Also add a short warmup trace to capture cold-start patterns.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale policy updated for project/seed-studio (min=2,max=20). Alert rule: p95 latency > 600ms -> page oncall.

claire: Measurement spec (quick): experiment_id=seed_studio_v1, n=160, arms=[all_upfront,drip], templates=[starter_kit,sample_apps], metrics=[day1_activation,week1_activation,cpl,webinar_conversion,time_to_first_success]. Dashboards: cohort dropoff, credit burn curve, A/B deltas.

jamie: Can we show a credit-burn curve widget and a time-to-first-success heatmap? @leah please mock. Also want per-arm CPL and token cost per activation.

leah: Will mock dashboard and share a Console link before EOD Tue. Also drafting email copy for both arms (drip email sequence differs).

nate: I'll drop hero drafts by Tue AM and final assets Wed EOD. Also prepping copy variations for paid socials.

aj: I'll wire the analytics events and routing tags by Wed. Also add a small attribution hack to credit office-hour attendees back to their arm.

samir: Pre-warm jobs scheduled. I'll upload the warmup script and ensure fallback logging is enabled. Will also run a short capacity smoke test Wed morning.

claire: Action items recap: @aj tagging + analytics, @samir infra pre-warm + fallback + smoke test, @leah dashboard + emails + micro-survey, @nate creative assets, @maya sampling/randomization plan. Sync Thu 9:30 to confirm readiness and go/no-go. Thanks team! :tada:
